node.label: Sandhoff disease
node.definition: A lysosomal disorder from the GM2 gangliosidosis family, caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in the HEXB gene, characterized by GM2 ganglioside accumulation in the nervous system and progressive central nervous system degeneration.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
